# Provenance: Project HERCULES | owner the owner | [id removed]
"""D3 CPU timing test: minimal fine-tune loop built from the OFFICIAL villa ink_detection training components
(villa 41701aa: make_model, load_model_state, create_loss, create_training_optimizer, prepare_model_input,
run_model_forward, prepare_loss_inputs, concatenate_deep_supervision_ignore, normalize_image(robust_mad),
flat_z_window_bbox, build_augmentations('default')), mirroring the inner step of
vesuvius/ink_detection/training/train.py::_run_training without Accelerate (not installed; fp16 AMP needs CUDA).
Starts from the base checkpoint weights (step-075000; optimizer state not restored). Recipe (fallback, section
4.D2 recipe not recorded in METHOD.md/repo): AdamW lr 2e-5 (official wd 3e-5, betas 0.9/0.999), official loss
(label-smoothed BCE 0.5 + 0.25 Dice, ignore label), grad clip 1.0, batch B, forward order, 17 x 128 x 128.
Inputs: official vc_render_tifxyz -n 31 at 9.366 um of ONE fold-A crop (0841 w00, canvas y0 512 x0 1664, 384 px);
C2-NT forward window = slices 7..23, official training jitter 17-of-21 (base 5..25, +-2). Targets: organizer
reference map on the same canvas (bank ref9): ink = ref >= 150, blank = ref <= 100, rest and ~valid9 ignored.
Patch origins on a 32 px grid inside the crop (official stride_xy 32). Arms only change labels/input order
(NULLA: labels permuted across the batch; REVA: depth-flipped input); compute is identical.
Numbers only: no image or pixel array is displayed."""
import os, sys, json, time, argparse, random, resource, hashlib, platform
os.environ.setdefault("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "3")
os.environ.setdefault("MKL_NUM_THREADS", "3")
import numpy as np
import torch

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=8)
ap.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=3)
ap.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=25)
ap.add_argument("--precision", choices=("fp32", "bf16"), default="fp32")
ap.add_argument("--arm", choices=("FA", "NULLA", "REVA", "CTRL"), default="FA")
ap.add_argument("--no-aug", action="store_true")
ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
args = ap.parse_args()

torch.set_num_threads(3)
torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
SEED = 42
random.seed(SEED); np.random.seed(SEED); torch.manual_seed(SEED)


def vmhwm_kb():
    for line in open("/proc/self/status"):
        if line.startswith("VmHWM:"):
            return int(line.split()[1])
    return None


def rss_kb():
    for line in open("/proc/self/status"):
        if line.startswith("VmRSS:"):
            return int(line.split()[1])
    return None


import copy
import zarr
from vesuvius.ink_detection.config import InkConfig, TrainingConfig, resolve_training_mapping
from vesuvius.ink_detection.models.model import make_model
from vesuvius.ink_detection.models.checkpoint import load_checkpoint, load_model_state
from vesuvius.ink_detection.training.losses import create_loss
from vesuvius.ink_detection.training.optimizers import create_training_optimizer
from vesuvius.ink_detection.training.train import prepare_model_input, prepare_loss_inputs
from vesuvius.ink_detection.training.stitching import run_model_forward
from vesuvius.ink_detection.training.deep_supervision import concatenate_deep_supervision_ignore
from vesuvius.ink_detection.data.normalization import normalize_image
from vesuvius.ink_detection.data.dataset import flat_z_window_bbox
from vesuvius.ink_detection.data.augmentations import build_augmentations

CK = "/work/ckpt/ink_9um/hybrid_3d2d-seed42/step-075000.pth"
RENDER = "/work/d3_timing/render/w00_x1664_y512_384.zarr"
SEG = "20260220213127-w00"
Y0, X0, S = 512, 1664, 384
t_load0 = time.perf_counter()
ck = load_checkpoint(CK)
mapping = copy.deepcopy(ck["config"])
mapping.update(optimizer="adamw", learning_rate=2e-5, batch_size=args.batch, num_iterations=2000,
               out_dir="/work/d3_timing/unused_out")
tc = TrainingConfig.from_mapping(resolve_training_mapping(mapping))
ink = tc.ink
model = make_model(ink)
load_model_state(model, ck["model"])                       # official loader (strict load_state_dict inside)
strict = model.load_state_dict(ck["model"], strict=True)   # explicit strict re-check
optimizer = create_training_optimizer(model, tc)
loss_fn = create_loss(ink)
t_load = time.perf_counter() - t_load0
rss_after_load = rss_kb()

# ---- data: one fold-A crop (render + teacher labels on the same canvas)
vol = np.asarray(zarr.open(f"{RENDER}/0", mode="r")[:])                      # (31, 384, 384) uint8
ref = np.load(f"/work/bank/0841/canvas9/{SEG}/ref9.npy", mmap_mode="r")[Y0:Y0 + S, X0:X0 + S]
val = np.load(f"/work/bank/0841/canvas9/{SEG}/valid9.npy", mmap_mode="r")[Y0:Y0 + S, X0:X0 + S].astype(bool)
ref = np.asarray(ref, dtype=np.float32)
ink_lab = (ref >= 150) & val
sup = ((ref >= 150) | (ref <= 100)) & val
label_stats = dict(ink_px=int(ink_lab.sum()), blank_px=int((sup & ~ink_lab).sum()),
                   ignored_px=int((~sup).sum()), crop_px=int(S * S))
del ref
origins = [(y, x) for y in range(0, S - 128 + 1, 32) for x in range(0, S - 128 + 1, 32)]
aug = None if args.no_aug else build_augmentations(ink.data.augmentation.preset, ink.data.patch_size,
                                                    rotation_axes=ink.data.augmentation.rotation_axes)
PZ = ink.data.patch_size[0]          # 17


def make_sample():
    y, x = random.choice(origins)
    # official flat z window: base 21 = render slices 5..25 (centre of -n 31), canonical 7..23 (= C2-NT forward),
    # training jitter +-2
    bbox, off = flat_z_window_bbox((5, y, x, 26, y + 128, x + 128), config=ink.data,
                                   do_augmentations=aug is not None, is_validation=False)
    z0, _, _, z1, _, _ = bbox
    img = vol[z0:z1, y:y + 128, x:x + 128]
    if args.arm == "REVA":
        img = img[::-1]
    img = normalize_image(np.ascontiguousarray(img), ink.data.normalization)
    lab = np.broadcast_to(ink_lab[y:y + 128, x:x + 128], (PZ, 128, 128)).astype(np.float32)
    sm = np.broadcast_to(sup[y:y + 128, x:x + 128], (PZ, 128, 128)).astype(np.float32)
    d = {"image": torch.from_numpy(np.ascontiguousarray(img)).float().unsqueeze(0),
         "inklabels": torch.from_numpy(lab.copy()).unsqueeze(0),
         "supervision_mask": torch.from_numpy(sm.copy()).unsqueeze(0)}
    if aug is not None:
        d = aug(**d)
    return {k: d[k] for k in ("image", "inklabels", "supervision_mask")}


def make_batch():
    items = [make_sample() for _ in range(args.batch)]
    b = {k: torch.stack([it[k] for it in items]) for k in items[0]}
    if args.arm == "NULLA":
        perm = torch.randperm(args.batch)
        b["inklabels"] = b["inklabels"][perm]
    return b


amp = torch.autocast("cpu", dtype=torch.bfloat16) if args.precision == "bf16" else torch.autocast("cpu", enabled=False)
recs = []
shapes = None
model.train()
t_all0 = time.perf_counter()
for step in range(args.warmup + args.steps):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    batch = make_batch()
    t1 = time.perf_counter()
    with amp:
        x = prepare_model_input(batch, tc)
        preds = run_model_forward(model, x, tc.model_crop_size, stitched=tc.use_stitched_forward,
                                  use_gradient_checkpointing=tc.stitched_gradient_checkpointing)
    lp, targets, ignore = prepare_loss_inputs(preds, batch, mode=ink.data.mode,
                                             force_full_supervision=tc.force_full_supervision)
    twi = concatenate_deep_supervision_ignore(targets, ignore, lp)
    loss = loss_fn(lp.float(), twi.float())
    if not torch.isfinite(loss):
        raise RuntimeError(f"non-finite loss at step {step}")
    loss.backward()
    gn = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), tc.grad_clip)
    optimizer.step()
    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    t2 = time.perf_counter()
    if shapes is None:
        shapes = dict(model_input=list(x.shape), model_output=list(preds.shape), targets=list(targets.shape),
                      targets_with_ignore=list(twi.shape), input_dtype=str(x.dtype), output_dtype=str(preds.dtype))
    recs.append(dict(step=step, data_s=t1 - t0, compute_s=t2 - t1, wall_s=t2 - t0, loss=float(loss.item()),
                     grad_norm=float(gn), supervised_frac=float((ignore <= 0).float().mean())))
    print(f"step {step} data {t1-t0:.3f} compute {t2-t1:.3f} loss {loss.item():.4f} gn {float(gn):.3f}", flush=True)
meas = recs[args.warmup:]
wall = np.array([r["wall_s"] for r in meas]); comp = np.array([r["compute_s"] for r in meas])
data = np.array([r["data_s"] for r in meas])
med = float(np.median(wall))
out = dict(
    provenance="Provenance: Project HERCULES | owner the owner | [id removed]",
    config=dict(batch=args.batch, warmup=args.warmup, steps=args.steps, precision=args.precision, arm=args.arm,
                augmentation=None if aug is None else ink.data.augmentation.preset, torch_threads=torch.get_num_threads(),
                interop_threads=torch.get_num_interop_threads(), OMP_NUM_THREADS=os.environ.get("OMP_NUM_THREADS"),
                torch=torch.__version__, python=platform.python_version(), cpu_count=os.cpu_count()),
    optimizer=dict(cls=type(optimizer).__name__, lr=optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"],
                   weight_decay=optimizer.param_groups[0]["weight_decay"], betas=list(optimizer.param_groups[0]["betas"])),
    strict_load=str(strict), n_params=int(sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())),
    n_trainable=int(sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)),
    shapes=shapes, label_stats_crop=label_stats, n_patch_origins=len(origins),
    load_s=t_load, rss_after_load_kb=rss_after_load,
    median_wall_s_per_step=med, mean_wall_s_per_step=float(wall.mean()), p90_wall_s=float(np.percentile(wall, 90)),
    min_wall_s=float(wall.min()), max_wall_s=float(wall.max()),
    median_compute_s_per_step=float(np.median(comp)), median_data_s_per_step=float(np.median(data)),
    projected_h_2000_steps=med * 2000 / 3600, projected_h_4_arms_sequential=4 * med * 2000 / 3600,
    peak_rss_kb_VmHWM=vmhwm_kb(), peak_rss_kb_ru_maxrss=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
    total_loop_s=time.perf_counter() - t_all0, steps=recs,
    script_sha256=hashlib.sha256(open(__file__, "rb").read()).hexdigest())
json.dump(out, open(args.out, "w"), indent=1)
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in out.items() if k != "steps"}, indent=1))
script_sources.select_crop.py:
# Provenance: Project HERCULES | owner the owner | [id removed]
"""D3 timing test: choose ONE small fold-A crop on ONE 0841 organizer segment (numbers only).
Exclusion exactly as logs/d1/d3_feas_count_B.json (DECL-D3-FEAS builder B method): pixel excluded iff inside
its segment's J window or its mesh point is < 128 vox (3-D) from any J mesh point; lower bound on distance from a
stride-4 subsample KD-tree minus the measured covering radius, exact full-res check in the ambiguous band.
Extra safety margin for the timing crop (declared here, before any result): every mesh-valid pixel of the crop
must have a certified 3-D distance >= 144 vox (128 + 15 vox half-depth of the -n 31 slab + 1 vox interpolation),
so no rendered voxel lies within 128 vox of a J mesh point. Crop rule: square S in (384, 320, 256) on a 64 px
grid; eligible iff 0 excluded px, mesh-valid everywhere, valid9 >= 90 %, min distance >= 144; choose the largest S
with any eligible crop whose ref9 text fraction (valid & ref9 >= 150) >= 2 %; ties: max text fraction, then smaller
y0, x0. No image or pixel array is displayed; only counts and coordinates are written."""
import os, json, time, hashlib, sys
os.environ.setdefault("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "3")
import numpy as np, tifffile
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

BANK = "/work/bank/0841"
SEG = "20260220213127-w00"
T = 128.0
MARGIN = 144.0
W = 3
OUT = sys.argv[1]
t0 = time.time()
bank = json.load(open(f"{BANK}/bank_0841.json"))
JW = bank["J_windows"]
SEGS = sorted(bank["segments"].keys())


def mesh(seg):
    ts = seg.split("-")[0]
    d = f"{BANK}/s3/PHerc0841/segments/{seg}/mesh/{ts}-on-20250821151531-9.366um.tifxyz"
    return np.stack([tifffile.imread(f"{d}/{c}.tif").astype(np.float64) for c in "xyz"], -1)


def canvas_points(xyz, rows, cols):
    G = xyz.shape[:2]
    gy = (rows + 0.5) / 20.0; i0 = np.floor(gy).astype(np.int64); fy = gy - i0
    gx = (cols + 0.5) / 20.0; j0 = np.floor(gx).astype(np.int64); fx = gx - j0
    okr = i0 + 1 < G[0]; okc = j0 + 1 < G[1]
    i0 = np.minimum(i0, G[0] - 2); j0 = np.minimum(j0, G[1] - 2)
    v = xyz[..., 0] != -1
    q = v[:-1, :-1] & v[1:, :-1] & v[:-1, 1:] & v[1:, 1:]
    valid = q[i0][:, j0] & okr[:, None] & okc[None, :]
    fy = fy[:, None, None]; fx = fx[None, :, None]
    A = xyz[i0][:, j0]; B = xyz[i0][:, j0 + 1]; C = xyz[i0 + 1][:, j0]; D = xyz[i0 + 1][:, j0 + 1]
    return (1 - fy) * ((1 - fx) * A + fx * B) + fy * ((1 - fx) * C + fx * D), valid


meshes = {s: mesh(s) for s in SEGS}
full_pts, sub_pts = [], []
for j in sorted(JW):
    w = JW[j]; s = w["segment"]; y0, x0, n = w["y0"], w["x0"], w["size"]
    P, V = canvas_points(meshes[s], np.arange(y0, y0 + n), np.arange(x0, x0 + n))
    full_pts.append(P[V]); sub_pts.append(P[1::4, 1::4][V[1::4, 1::4]])
    del P, V
full_pts = np.concatenate(full_pts); sub_pts = np.concatenate(sub_pts)
sub_tree = cKDTree(sub_pts)
e = 0.0
for k in range(0, len(full_pts), 2_000_000):
    d, _ = sub_tree.query(full_pts[k:k + 2_000_000], k=1, workers=W)
    e = max(e, float(d.max()))
e_used = e + 1e-6
full_tree = None

H, Wd = meshes[SEG].shape[0] * 20, meshes[SEG].shape[1] * 20
inJ = np.zeros((H, Wd), bool)
for j, w in JW.items():
    if w["segment"] == SEG:
        inJ[w["y0"]:w["y0"] + w["size"], w["x0"]:w["x0"] + w["size"]] = True
MV = np.zeros((H, Wd), bool)
lb = np.full((H, Wd), -np.inf)        # certified lower bound on 3-D distance to J (inf-capped)
BLK = 512
n_amb = 0
for r0 in range(0, H, BLK):
    rows = np.arange(r0, min(H, r0 + BLK))
    P, V = canvas_points(meshes[SEG], rows, np.arange(Wd))
    MV[rows] = V
    q = V & ~inJ[rows]
    idx = np.flatnonzero(q)
    Pf = P.reshape(-1, 3)
    dsub = np.full(q.size, np.inf)
    if len(idx):
        d, _ = sub_tree.query(Pf[idx], k=1, workers=W, distance_upper_bound=MARGIN + e_used + 1.0)
        dsub[idx] = d
    blk_lb = dsub - e_used
    # exact distance where the lower bound is inconclusive for the MARGIN test (covers the 128 band too)
    amb = q.reshape(-1) & (dsub < MARGIN + e_used) & (dsub >= T)
    amb_idx = np.flatnonzero(amb)
    n_amb += len(amb_idx)
    if len(amb_idx):
        if full_tree is None:
            full_tree = cKDTree(full_pts)
        dex, _ = full_tree.query(Pf[amb_idx], k=1, workers=W, distance_upper_bound=MARGIN + e_used + 2.0)
        blk_lb[amb_idx] = dex
    blk_lb[~q.reshape(-1)] = -np.inf
    lb[rows] = blk_lb.reshape(len(rows), Wd)
    del P, V, Pf, dsub, blk_lb
excluded = inJ | (MV & (lb < T))
valid = np.load(f"{BANK}/canvas9/{SEG}/valid9.npy").astype(bool)
ref = np.load(f"{BANK}/canvas9/{SEG}/ref9.npy")
txt = valid & (ref >= 150)
del ref


def sat(m):
    a = np.zeros((m.shape[0] + 1, m.shape[1] + 1), np.int64)
    a[1:, 1:] = m.astype(np.int64).cumsum(0).cumsum(1)
    return a


def boxsum(a, ys, xs, S):
    Y = ys[:, None]; X = xs[None, :]
    return a[Y + S, X + S] - a[Y, X + S] - a[Y + S, X] + a[Y, X]


far = MV & (lb >= MARGIN)
Sv, Sm, Sx, St, Sf = sat(valid), sat(MV), sat(excluded), sat(txt), sat(far)
# PRIMARY count reproduction (stride 64, 128 px tiles, >= 90 % valid, 0 excluded, text >= 2 %)
ys = np.arange(0, H - 128 + 1, 64); xs = np.arange(0, Wd - 128 + 1, 64)
nv = boxsum(Sv, ys, xs, 128); ne = boxsum(Sx, ys, xs, 128); nt = boxsum(St, ys, xs, 128)
elig = (10 * nv >= 9 * 128 * 128) & (ne == 0)
primary = dict(eligible=int(elig.sum()), text_ref9=int((elig & (100 * nt >= 2 * nv)).sum()))
choice = None
cands = {}
for S in (384, 320, 256):
    ys = np.arange(0, H - S + 1, 64); xs = np.arange(0, Wd - S + 1, 64)
    nv = boxsum(Sv, ys, xs, S); nm = boxsum(Sm, ys, xs, S); nx = boxsum(Sx, ys, xs, S)
    nt = boxsum(St, ys, xs, S); nf = boxsum(Sf, ys, xs, S)
    ok = (nx == 0) & (nm == S * S) & (nf == S * S) & (10 * nv >= 9 * S * S) & (100 * nt >= 2 * nv)
    cands[S] = int(ok.sum())
    if ok.any() and choice is None:
        frac = np.where(ok, nt / np.maximum(nv, 1), -1.0)
        best = frac.max()
        a, b = [(a, b) for a, b in zip(*np.nonzero(frac == best))][0]   # row-major -> smaller y0 then x0
        y0, x0 = int(ys[a]), int(xs[b])
        crop_lb = lb[y0:y0 + S, x0:x0 + S]
        choice = dict(S=S, y0=y0, x0=x0, text_frac_valid=float(best), valid_frac=float(nv[a, b] / (S * S)),
                      min_3d_dist_lowerbound_vox=float(crop_lb.min()),
                      n_primary_tiles_s64_inside=int(((S - 128) // 64 + 1) ** 2))
res = dict(provenance="Provenance: Project HERCULES | owner the owner | [id removed]",
           segment=SEG, canvas_hw=[H, Wd], e_cover_radius_vox=e, n_J_full=int(len(full_pts)),
           ambiguous_exact_px=int(n_amb), excluded_px=int(excluded.sum()),
           nonexcluded_valid_px=int((valid & ~excluded).sum()),
           far144_valid_px=int((valid & far & ~excluded).sum()),
           primary_reproduction=primary, candidates_per_size=cands, choice=choice,
           seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 1),
           script_sha256=hashlib.sha256(open(__file__, "rb").read()).hexdigest())
